Locally served Bootstrap assets
===============================

Bootstrap 5.3.3
- Files: bootstrap-5.3.3/bootstrap.min.css, bootstrap-5.3.3/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
- Source: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v5.3.3
- Package files: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/
- License: bootstrap-5.3.3/LICENSE (MIT)

Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3
- Files: bootstrap-icons-1.11.3/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css and font files
- Source: https://github.com/twbs/icons/tree/v1.11.3
- Package files: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/
- License: bootstrap-icons-1.11.3/LICENSE (MIT)

These are the exact versions previously referenced by index.html. The CSS and
JavaScript files are unmodified distribution files. Bootstrap JavaScript uses
the bundle build, which includes Popper. The icons CSS resolves its font files
relative to font/fonts/.
